messages:
Ashley G.: Quick kickoff — VertexLabs co-hosted 'Live Labs: Inference at Scale' on 2026-10-14. Thread for speaker slots, demo run order, and physical swag handoff.
Mike L.: Confirming AJ and Priya as Redwood speakers. Need to lock Vertex speaker (Tom?).
Tom V.: Yep I'll present the OnPrem connector + autoscaling slide. Planning a 6-min live demo of Dedicated.
Priya R.: I'll cover canary rollouts + failure fallbacks. Can we keep demos to 12min total? Ops prefers short.
Kara (Events): Venue has 6x 2-minute lightning slots for partners + 35min main demo block. Sound good?
Ashley G.: Good. Proposed order: Intro (Ashley) -> Vertex lightning -> Redwood demo -> Q&A -> Partner lightning.
Jordan (Ops): For live demo we need a spare A100 on-site or guaranteed remote GPU with <50ms p90. Which do you prefer?
Tom V.: Remote Dedicated instance works if we have failover. I'll bring a pre-recorded short clip as fallback.
Mike L.: Please add a canary fallback: if p90 > 200ms for more than 3s switch to pre-recorded stream.
Priya R.: I'll add a short health-check probe to the demo script. Pseudocode: 
```
# demo healthprobe
curl -sS https://demo.redwood.example/health || echo "fail" && fallback_to_video
```
Kara (Events): Swag plan: 200 partner bundles. Need final ship-by date Oct 7 to the venue. Address below.
Kara (Events): Venue shipping address: 
"Event Logistics Co."
ATTN: Exhibit Hall B, 2026 Demo Lane
San Jose, CA 95110
(Please pack batteries separately — rules)
Tom V.: Can Vertex ship 100 partner kits directly? We can handle the remaining 100.
Ashley G.: Yes. Tom, coordinate with Jordan for customs forms and labels.
Jordan (Ops): Please fill this short form for customs: https://forms.reedx.example/partner-shipping — deadline Sep 30.
Mike L.: Demo checklist for Redwood side: 1) model pinned to v1.3 2) quantized bucket ready 3) canary policy configured 4) fallback video uploaded to S3.
Priya R.: I'll own items 1-3. Uploading fallback video Monday to s3://redwood-events/live-labs/vertex-fallback.mp4
logistics-bot: Reminder set — shipping deadline Sep 30 @09:00 PDT.
Kara (Events): AV ask: HDMI + capture, 1x backup laptop, network tested on Oct 12. Please test remote connectivity on Oct 10.
Tom V.: Agreed. We'll run full remote rehearsal Oct 10 @10:00 PT. Can everyone confirm availability?
Ashley G.: Confirmed. Priya confirmed. Mike can you join as backup?
Mike L.: I'll be on call for Oct 10 rehearsal and switchovers on event day.
Jordan (Ops): For monitoring during demo — enable per-route tracing and token-level cost logs. If any route crosses 5x cost baseline, trigger alert to #eng-oncall.
Priya R.: Noted. I'll add a Grafana panel and short-run alert rule.
Kara (Events): Swag pickup day at HQ Oct 8 09:00. Volunteers? Need 4 people to kit 200 bundles.
Mike L.: I can handle two. Ashley G.: I can do one morning shift. Tom V.: Vertex will send 2 folks to help pack.
Ashley G.: Action items list: Mike (rehearse + backup), Priya (demo scripts + alerts), Tom (partner speaker + pre-record fallback), Jordan (customs + network), Kara (shipping + volunteers). I'll compile and send a calendar invite.
Tom V.: Also, small ask — can we include a one-page partner datasheet in the kits? PDF attached in the thread.
Kara (Events): PDF received. Will print 200 copies. Any branding constraints? Keep Redwood logo to top-left, Vertex to top-right.
Ashley G.: Approved. Keep fonts legible. No more than 1 page.
logistics-bot: Calendar invites sent to participants for Oct 10 rehearsal and Oct 14 event.
Jordan (Ops): Final note: if live demo fails, plan B is to run recorded video + live Q&A. Everyone OK with that?
All: :thumbsup:
Ashley G.: Thanks team — I'll post rehearsal agenda by EOD.
